text: Basically, not having it is more than a
20% damage loss. And that is assuming
you have the second best in slot. He is
by far the most signature reliant
character in the entire game. And I
don't think anyone except Yinland even
comes close in this regard. But even
despite this, I think Brandt is a good
7.5 out of 10 poll. So, who are you
going to be pulling in the second half
of Withering Waves 2.3? I have my eyes
on Chicona as I am a Phoebe main. All
the other characters I already have,
except for Roachia, who doesn't really
interest me, but let me know in the
comments below. And while you're down
there, be sure to like the video and
subscribe to the channel. If you have
any questions, be sure to join my
Discord. I'm pretty active in there, so
if you ask your question, there's a
pretty good chance I'll respond.
